'''Thinking gardens''' were public parks in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Caronath]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]]. They consisted of small spaces that were separated by natural barriers like trees and rocks. Thinking gardens could be rented as meeting places and for quiet contemplation, and their privacy was respected by everyone.
